name: homebase
description: Voice-first household logistics skill for Alexa+. Manages chores, grocery lists, calendar events, schedule conflicts, and fair effort rebalancing over Streamable HTTP.
author: Homebase Team

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List all members of the household with roles and colors.

tools.name: add_chore
tools.description: Add a new chore to the household chore board.

tools.name: assign_chore
tools.description: Assign an existing chore to a household member by name.

tools.name: rebalance_chores
tools.description: Redistribute open chores fairly across all household members by effort points, taking into account age roles (parents, teens, kids).

tools.name: add_grocery_item
tools.description: Add an item to the household grocery list, merging quantities if already present.

tools.name: list_groceries
tools.description: List all items on the grocery list grouped by category.

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Add a calendar event for one or more household members.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List calendar events in a date range, optionally filtering to one member.

tools.name: find_conflicts
tools.description: Check for calendar conflicts, overlapping appointments, double-booked members, or schedule breaks when a member travels.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a time-based reminder for a specific household member.

tools.name: weekly_summary
tools.description: Get a comprehensive weekly summary of events, open chores, needed groceries, and active reminders.

intents.name: RebalanceChores
sampleUtterances: Assign dishes and laundry fairly this week.
Divide open chores equally by effort.

intents.name: FindScheduleConflicts
sampleUtterances: Dad's traveling Thursday, what does that break?
Are there any schedule conflicts this week?

intents.name: AddGrocery
sampleUtterances: We're out of milk and eggs.
Add sourdough bread to the grocery list.

intents.name: CreateReminder
sampleUtterances: Remind Meera about the dentist on Thursday at 4.
Remind Riya about math homework at 6pm.

privacy.cloudRetention: Zero cloud retention; strictly $0 budget and zero credit card required
